title: In the dark theme the tile date picker is fully dark
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • The app is in the dark theme.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Click the Revenue tile's date pill.
  3. Look at the whole picker: presets, calendar, range text and buttons.
  4. Press Escape, click Reports in the top bar, click Sales and open its Date filter.
  5. Compare it with the tile's picker.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Every part of the picker is dark, with near-white presets, range text and buttons. There is no white panel and no dark text on a dark background.
  • Step 5: The tile's picker looks like the report's Date filter.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9584 (Story 12, Visual Conformance); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S12-R11 (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 13 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet, one rule per defect ticket SV-11245; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14); read 14 Oct 2026.
